starting_state: Planning or execution needs prior settled context, an operator inspects capability standing, a capability changes tier, or a derived memory or capability view is missing, stale, or suspect.
preconditions: Authoritative source records and qualifying settlements
intention: Reuse settled history and evidence-backed capability without allowing indexes, summaries, or stale projections to become authoritative.
job: Recall relevant memory under disclosure authority, inspect what influenced work, assess capability quality, and route future work from the same qualifying evidence.
authority_requirements: Attributable actor context and role resolution
Policy digest binding against active snapshot
expected_consequential_state_transitions: capability moves among attempted, demonstrated, proven, degraded, quarantined, and contracted through qualifying evidence
stale projections become rebuilt equivalent views without changing source truth.
settlement_condition: Reused knowledge or capability is disclosure-safe, traceable to source settlements, explicit about scope and weakness, and linked to the resulting plan, decision, answer, or settlement.
expected_next_decisions_and_affordances: Route work through a demonstrated capability
narrow or quarantine a regressed capability
applicable_failure_and_recovery_behavior: Fall back to authoritative scans when indexes fail
contract capability on regression or lost proof
require fresh qualifying settlements to leave contracted standing.
expected_unavailable_states: workbench capability browser and memory store browser (/memory, /capabilities) are preview-only
